mapper.select: select id, channel_code, channel_name, app_id, public_key, private_key, notify_url, return_url, gateway_url, sign_type, charset, pay_environment, enabled, remark, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id from payment_config where id = #{value}

select id, channel_code, channel_name, app_id, public_key, private_key, notify_url, return_url, gateway_url, sign_type, charset, pay_environment, enabled, remark, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id from payment_config where channel_code = #{channelCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into payment_config ( channel_code, channel_name, app_id, public_key, private_key, notify_url, return_url, gateway_url, sign_type, charset, pay_environment, enabled, remark, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id ) values ( #{channelCode}, #{channelName}, #{appId}, #{publicKey}, #{privateKey}, #{notifyUrl}, #{returnUrl}, #{gatewayUrl}, #{signType}, #{charset}, #{payEnvironment}, #{enabled}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUserId} )
